headline: Macro favors Capital (Labor Share 93.7, Profits/Wages +7.5%); Equities show 3M pullback in AI hardware (-27.25%) vs. IT/Staffing bounce (-4.74%)

bullets.title: Labor Share Compression
bullets.text: BLS Nonfarm Labor Share stands at 93.73 (-0.67% QoQ, -1.60% YoY), remaining structurally below the 2017=100 baseline.
bullets.reason: Real output growth is accruing to capital owners faster than compensation: nonfarm payrolls sit at 159.3M with average weekly hours capped at 34.4h and hourly earnings at $38.00/hr.

bullets.title: Profits Outpacing Wages
bullets.text: Corporate Profits-to-Wage-Bill ratio hit 0.414 (+2.56% QoQ, +18.65% YoY).
bullets.reason: BEA Corporate Profits expanded to $4,419.0B SAAR (+3.25% QoQ, +23.08% YoY) while the annualized private wage bill grew only +0.47% MoM (+4.30% YoY) to $10,827.8B.

bullets.title: Watchlist Spread Drivers
bullets.text: 3M Watchlist Spread is -22.51pp (Capital Enablers -27.25% vs. Labor-Heavy -4.74%).
bullets.reason: Short-term multiple compression hit AI hardware/power names (SMCI (-44.0%), VRT (-39.2%), NVDA (-37.6%)), while oversold IT outsourcers & staffing rebounded (EPAM (+45.6%), INFY (+9.2%), CTSH (-0.3%)). Over 1Y, hardware/grid winners (ANET (+24.5%), PWR (+20.8%), GEV (+18.7%)) still anchor the capex cycle.

bullets.title: AI & Power Capex Catalyst
bullets.text: "Trio of Japanese real estate developers invest in 15MW Hokkaido data center development" (Data Center Dynamics).
bullets.reason: Compute & silicon capex expansion shifting income toward capital owners. Also tracked: "Ohio regulators approve up to 800MW gas plant set to power EdgeConneX data center in Pickaway County" (Data Center Dynamics).

bullets.title: Workforce & Macro Signal
bullets.text: "U.S. GDP Growth in Q3 Revised Up Markedly; Corporate Profits Solid" (Haver Analytics) — with U.S. unemployment at 4.1% (2026-10-01).
bullets.reason: Output & margin expansion decoupling from payroll growth.
